headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, while the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, and the Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.

Injuries continue to impact teams across the league. The Toronto Blue Jays placed right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss on the 60-day injured list. The Detroit Tigers placed left fielder Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Colorado Rockies placed third baseman Kyle Karros on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. The Athletics placed left-handed pitcher José Suarez on the 15-day injured list with a right hip strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox transferred second baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. The New York Yankees placed right-handed pitcher Kervin Castro on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow neuritis. The Cincinnati Reds transferred right-handed pitcher Hunter Greene from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow soreness.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a deal involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the Orioles their loss. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Kyle Leahy, who pitched 5.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
